verdict.rationale: The SAML custom-app docs confirm that a pre-integrated SSO catalog exists, since they give steps for apps "not in the pre-integrated catalog" (docs-25). Users can sign into company cloud apps with their managed Google credentials (docs-18). Auto-provisioning is documented for at least one third-party app, Office 365 (docs-13, docs-26). However, nothing shows the catalog's size, its breadth of coverage, or how quickly integrations connect. Missing for 10: evidence of catalog size (thousands of apps), OIDC pre-built integrations, minutes-to-connect setup, and independent corroboration of catalog coverage.
